section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the factor structure and validity of a Chinese (Cantonese) translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) among 457 women and 417 men from a university in Hong Kong. The study found that the Chinese BAS-2 had a one-dimensional structure similar to the English version, with body appreciation scores showing significant associations with BMI, self-esteem, life satisfaction, and (in women) weight discrepancy, and men scoring significantly higher than women.
